# Verification Results

**1) Live preview in browser-chrome frame?** ✅ Yes. The preview sits inside a browser frame with macOS-style traffic lights (red/yellow/green dots) and an address bar reading `fuoco&figli.com — live preview`. It shows a real rendered restaurant website: a masthead ("VOL. XVII · FITZROY, MELBOURNE", "WEDNESDAY 4 NOVEMBER 2026", "THREE ROOMS ON GERTRUDE & KERR"), the "Fuoco & Figli" brand name, a nav bar (Venues & menus, Private events, Careers, Book a table button), a hero with "THE FAMILY · SINCE 2009" and the headline "Three rooms," alongside a real photo of a rustic tavern table with food and a kvass mug. This matches the copy: "Fuoco & Figli is live below... The preview is the real site, not a mockup."

**2) Skin options / edition names visible?** ⚠️ Not in this screenshot. The section says "re-skin it with one click," so skin/edition options presumably exist, but none are visible in the captured viewport — likely they appear below the fold or the screenshot is cropped mid-preview.

**3) Desktop/Mobile toggle and 'Shuffle the look'?** ✅ Yes to both. Above the preview frame: "🖥 Desktop | 📱 Mobile" toggle on the left and "🔀 Shuffle the look" button on the right.

**4) Errors or rendering problems?** ✅ None visible. Everything renders cleanly — no broken images, overflow, missing assets, or error states. The only note: the preview is cut off at the bottom of the screenshot (partial hero image), which appears to be viewport cropping, not a rendering fault.

**Summary:** All structural requirements of the Design step are present (browser-framed live preview, real restaurant render, device toggle, shuffle button). The only gap is skin/edition options not being visible within this crop.
